resolution: Added painter-controlled grass density: three grass tile variants the user paints for low/med/high — 'Grass (Sparse)' (3 blades/cell), 'Grass' (7, existing), 'Grass (Lush)' (16). Appended grassSparse/grassLush to TILE_KIND_DEFINITIONS LAST (existing indices stay stable) + the TileKind union; they auto-appear in the painter palette (PAINTABLE_TILE_KINDS filters placement==='surface'). Density now lives in a GRASS_DENSITY kind->blades table in grassPopulation.ts; both grass sources (surfaceRegions by kind, landform field.tiles by TILE_KINDS index) look density up per cell and emitClump scatters that many blades. Works identically in the editor iso/play view and the compiled /compiled bake (same generator). hmsc-int rebuilt clean, boot self-shot PASS; world_loader needs no rebuild (density is bake-side TS). A new density level = one GRASS_DENSITY entry + one tile kind, no other wiring.
